name: Zeus
loreTies: Source: Zeus (sky authority, thunder verdict, kingship)
shortBackstory: Zeus is the sovereign protector of the Celestial Heights — the Zeus-source: sky authority whose thunder verdict is law. No appeal survives the strike.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Zeus was born from the thunder that decides — the bolt that splits sky from earth. He is the defender whose authority is not earned but declared. Ancient humans saw him as Zeus — but they saw the throne, not the cost. Zeus does not sit on authority; he stands inside it, and the lightning is the weight of standing.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Olympian, Zeus is the sky. Every Deity operates beneath his thunder verdict. His authority sets the ceiling: nothing rises above his judgment. He leads through the certainty that when he speaks, the sky agrees.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Zeus by silencing his thunder. The lightning still struck, but the thunder was absent. A verdict without thunder is just light. The wound taught him that power without witness is not power — it is just force no one heard.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In the Laurel Senate Trials, Zeus anchors the legal frame. His heaven-marrow shield creates a zone of sovereign law. But his thunder has been erased — verdicts strike, but no one hears them land. The campaign tests whether authority can function without witness.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Zeus's flaw is certainty without humility. He has never been wrong because being wrong would mean the sky is wrong. The Hollow teaches him that certainty without witness is just noise. His conflict: is the sovereign who has never been questioned a leader or a tyrant?

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
human_echo: Greek temples were miniature copies of the Olympian Sky Arena; Zeus's thunderbolt was the real lightning
